sop_modules.name: Metal RP Mobilization & Access Staging
sop_modules.description: Crew mobilization, equipment staging with RP-specific tools (wire brushes, grinders, needle gun, rust converter, solvent degreaser), and scaffold/lift setup when access_type requires elevated platforms.

tasks.name: Crew Mobilization & Equipment Staging
tasks.description: Load truck with metal RP-specific equipment: wire brushes, scraper, grinder with wire wheel, needle gun (if heavy rust), solvent/degreaser, rust converter, DTM primers, DTM topcoat, spray equipment (if spray method), PPE (respirator, eye protection), fire extinguisher. Stage at work area.

quality_notes.all: All RP-specific tools and materials on site. Verify primer compatibility with substrate type. Confirm rust converter is available if rust conditions expected.

tasks.name: Scaffold / Lift Setup
tasks.description: Set up scaffold or lift for elevated metal work — gutters at roofline, second-story railings, ornamental iron at height.

quality_notes.all: OSHA compliance mandatory. Scaffold on firm, level ground. Safety rails on all open sides.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Mobilize crew and equipment -> Scaffold/lift setup (if applicable). Complete before protection or prep.

sop_modules.name: Metal RP Protection & Masking
sop_modules.description: Deploy protection for landscaping, hardscape, siding, light fixtures, and roof edges adjacent to metal work areas. Metal prep generates heavier debris than standard painting — rust flakes, grinding dust, wire brush fragments.

tasks.name: Landscape Protection at Metal Base
tasks.description: Deploy plastic sheeting or canvas along base of metal surfaces. Metal RP prep generates heavy debris — 4-6 mil plastic minimum.

quality_notes.all: Extend 3-4 ft from metal base. Secure edges — metal debris is heavier than paint chips.

tasks.name: Hardscape Protection Below Metal
tasks.description: Deploy canvas and plastic over walkways, patios, driveways adjacent to metal work areas. Rust converter and primer drips on concrete are extremely difficult to remove.

quality_notes.all: Canvas for crew traffic (non-slip). Full plastic for spray method.

tasks.name: Siding Protection Behind Metal Components
tasks.description: Deploy plastic sheeting on siding behind railings, downspouts, ornamental iron. Upgrade to full sheeting for spray method.

quality_notes.all: Full plastic 4-6 ft on siding for spray. Check wind before spray — overspray drift is a callback.

tasks.name: Light Fixture Bagging & Masking
tasks.description: Bag and tape light fixtures mounted on or adjacent to metal components.

quality_notes.all: Bag fully. Disconnect power if accessible.

tasks.name: Roof Edge Protection for Gutter Work
tasks.description: Deploy drop cloth at roof shingle line where gutter attaches to fascia. Prevents primer/paint drips on shingles.

quality_notes.all: Lay cloth along shingle line. Secure against wind. Primer drips on shingles = permanent stain.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Deploy all protection before any prep work. Landscape/hardscape first, then siding, then fixtures, then roof edge.

sop_modules.name: Existing Metal Condition Assessment
sop_modules.description: MANDATORY first assessment for RP. Visual and tactile assessment of existing metal condition — rust grade, coating adhesion, substrate type identification, structural integrity gate check. Drives prep task activation, primer routing, and condition modifier assignment.

tasks.name: Visual & Tactile Condition Assessment
tasks.description: Assess all metal surfaces for: (1) rust grade — flash, moderate, heavy, structural, (2) existing paint adhesion — knife test, cross-hatch, (3) substrate type — magnet test for ferrous vs non-ferrous, (4) profile complexity classification, (5) contamination (oil/grease). Document findings per component.

quality_notes.all: Magnet test for ferrous/non-ferrous. Probe all rust areas. Document per component. Assessment drives entire prep path.

tasks.name: Coating Adhesion Test
tasks.description: ASTM D3359 cross-hatch adhesion test on existing paint. Determines if existing coating is sound (adhesion passes) or failing (adhesion fails). Drives substrate state assignment.

quality_notes.all: Test representative areas per component. Document adhesion rating per ASTM D3359.

tasks.name: Structural Rust / Section Loss Gate Check
tasks.description: GATE TASK — HARD STOP. Inspect for structural rust: section loss >25%, perforation, load-bearing joint failure. If found, STOP WORK — structural repair required before painting.

gate_rules.pass_condition: No structural section loss, perforation, or load-bearing joint failure detected
gate_rules.fail_action: HARD_STOP — Report to project manager. Structural metal repair required.

quality_notes.all: Probe rust areas with screwdriver — surface rust flakes, structural rust penetrates. Check base plates, weld joints, load-bearing connections. Document with photos.

tasks.name: Lead Paint Test (Pre-1978 Gate)
tasks.description: Test existing coating for lead on pre-1978 structures. XRF gun or EPA-recognized test kit. If positive, scope escalates to RRP-certified contractor.

quality_notes.all: Test per EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745. If lead-positive, STOP — RRP scope.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Condition assessment -> Adhesion test -> Structural rust check -> Lead test (pre-1978). All assessments BEFORE any prep work.

sop_modules.name: Condition-Driven Surface Preparation
sop_modules.description: Surface prep driven by condition assessment findings. Tasks activate based on substrate state and substrate type. SP1 solvent clean is ALWAYS first. Mechanical prep escalates by rust grade. Condition modifier (FAC_MTRP_CONDITION) applies to this module's tasks.

tasks.name: Power Wash Metal Surfaces
tasks.description: Power wash all metal surfaces (1000-1500 PSI) to remove loose rust, chalk, dirt, cobwebs, and loose paint. Metal is power-wash safe. Prerequisite to SP1 solvent clean — removes gross contamination so solvent wipe is effective.

quality_notes.all: 1000-1500 PSI. Remove all loose material. Allow surface to dry before solvent clean.

tasks.name: SP1 Solvent Cleaning (Mandatory)
tasks.description: SSPC-SP1 solvent wipe ALL metal surfaces with solvent-dampened rags to remove oil, grease, fingerprints, and contaminants. MANDATORY first prep step for ALL metal. Clean rags only.

quality_notes.QT2: All surfaces wiped. No visible contamination.
quality_notes.QT3: All surfaces wiped clean. No visible oil, grease, or contaminants.
quality_notes.QT4: All surfaces wiped clean. White rag test passes (no transfer).

tasks.name: SP2 Hand Tool Prep (Wire Brush / Hand Sand)
tasks.description: SSPC-SP2 hand tool cleaning — wire brush, hand scraper, sandpaper to remove loose rust, loose paint, and mill scale. For flash rust and light surface conditions.

quality_notes.QT3: All loose material removed. Surface free of loose material.
quality_notes.QT4: All loose material removed. Adjacent areas feathered smooth.

tasks.name: SP3 Power Tool Prep (Grinder / Wire Wheel)
tasks.description: SSPC-SP3 power tool cleaning — angle grinder with wire wheel or flap disc. Removes tight rust, mill scale, and failing paint down to bright metal. For moderate/heavy rust and failing paint.

quality_notes.QT2: Tight rust and failing paint removed from treatment areas.
quality_notes.QT3: Complete removal to bright metal in treatment areas.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete removal to bright metal. Uniform profile. No skip areas.

tasks.name: Needle Gun / Power Scraper for Heavy Scale
tasks.description: Needle gun or power scraper for heavy rust scale deposits that resist grinder wire wheel. Pneumatic or electric needle scaler breaks apart thick scale and deep pit corrosion. For heavy rust grade only.

quality_notes.QT2: Heavy scale removed. Surface prepped for SP3 follow-up.
quality_notes.QT3: All scale deposits removed. Ready for SP3 final profile.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete scale removal. Documented. SP3 follows for final profile.

tasks.name: Degloss Existing Sound Coating
tasks.description: Scuff-sand or liquid degloss existing sound paint to create adhesion profile. Only on SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT_METAL.

tasks.name: Strip Failing Existing Coating
tasks.description: Remove failing existing coating by scraping, chemical stripper, or aggressive mechanical methods. For extensively failed coatings (>30% failure area).

quality_notes.QT3: All failing coating removed. Smooth transitions.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete removal. Smooth feathered transitions documented.

tasks.name: Aluminum Surface Abrasion
tasks.description: Abrade aluminum surfaces with Scotch-Brite pads or 180-grit sandpaper. CRITICAL: primer must be applied within 15 minutes — Al2O3 oxide reforms.

quality_notes.all: Uniform scuff pattern. Primed within 15 min of each section.

tasks.name: Galvanized Surface Cleaning (Vinegar / Ammonia Wash)
tasks.description: Clean galvanized surfaces to remove white rust, passivation oils, zinc salts. Vinegar wash or ammonia solution. Rinse thoroughly.

quality_notes.all: Passivation oils removed. Water sheeting test passes.

tasks.name: Rust Conversion Treatment
tasks.description: Apply rust converter to transform iron oxide to stable ferric phosphate/tannate. After mechanical prep, on residual rust. 24 hr cure before priming. Best for intricate profiles where power tools cannot reach.

quality_notes.QT2: Converter applied to rusty areas. Surface turned black.
quality_notes.QT3: Complete conversion. All areas verified. No active rust.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete conversion documented. All areas verified.

tasks.name: Post-Prep Dust and Debris Clean
tasks.description: Remove all grinding dust, wire brush debris, and rust particles after prep. Compressed air, tack cloth, vacuum drop cloths. Must be done between prep and prime.

quality_notes.all: Surface free of visible dust and debris. Drop cloths cleaned.

tasks.name: Caulk Metal-to-Building Junctions
tasks.description: Apply polyurethane sealant at metal-to-building junctions (railing post bases, gutter end caps, downspout brackets, ornamental mounting points). NOT silicone. Prevents moisture intrusion behind metal.

quality_notes.QT4: All junctions sealed. Tooled smooth. Consistent bead width.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Power wash -> SP1 solvent clean -> Mechanical prep (SP2/SP3/needle gun per condition) -> Substrate-specific prep (aluminum abrade/galvanized clean) -> Rust convert (if applicable) -> Dust clean -> Caulk junctions.

sop_modules.name: Condition-Driven Primer Application
sop_modules.description: Primer path driven by substrate_state + substrate_type. Spot prime on sound existing (bare areas only). Full prime after rust treatment or strip. Primer chemistry matches substrate type.

tasks.name: Prime — DTM Acrylic, Brush
tasks.description: Brush-apply DTM acrylic primer to ferrous metal surfaces. Standard primer for steel/iron RP. Spot or full depending on condition.

quality_notes.QT2: Coverage on all bare areas. No holidays.
quality_notes.QT3: Complete coverage. Uniform film. All profiles coated.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete coverage. Uniform film build. No runs or sags.

tasks.name: Prime — DTM Acrylic, Spray
tasks.description: Spray-apply DTM acrylic primer to ferrous metal surfaces. For production runs (gutters, straight railings).

quality_notes.QT4: Complete coverage. Uniform film build. No holidays.

tasks.name: Prime — DTM Alkyd, Brush (Pitted Surfaces)
tasks.description: Brush-apply DTM alkyd primer to heavily pitted ferrous metal. Superior wetting flows into pits. BLOCKED on galvanized and aluminum.

quality_notes.QT3: Complete coverage. Primer worked into all pits.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete coverage. All pits filled. Uniform film.

tasks.name: Prime — Etch Primer, Brush (Galvanized / Aluminum)
tasks.description: Brush-apply etch primer to exposed non-ferrous metal. Creates chemical adhesion profile. Thin film — do NOT over-apply. For aluminum: apply within 15 min of abrading.

quality_notes.all: Thin uniform coat. Complete coverage. Applied within prime window (aluminum).

tasks.name: Prime — Bonding Primer, Brush (Sound Existing Non-Ferrous)
tasks.description: Brush-apply bonding primer over sound existing coating on non-ferrous metal after degloss. Adhesion bridge between existing and new coating.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage over deglosed surface. Uniform film.

tasks.name: Spot Prime Bare Areas on Sound Existing
tasks.description: Spot-prime bare metal areas exposed during prep on otherwise sound existing coating. Brush-only for precision.

quality_notes.QT3: All bare spots primed. No exposed metal.
quality_notes.QT4: All bare spots primed. Feathered edges.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Primer selection driven by substrate_type + substrate_state. Spot prime on sound existing. Full prime after rust treatment or strip. DTM acrylic/alkyd for ferrous, etch for bare non-ferrous, bonding for sound existing non-ferrous.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat Application
sop_modules.description: DTM acrylic finish — 2 coats. Application method drives task selection. Brush for detail work and small items. Spray for production runs.

tasks.name: Finish Coat — DTM Acrylic, Brush
tasks.description: Brush-apply DTM acrylic finish coat. Per coat — 2 coats total. Brush for railings, ornamental profiles, detail work.

quality_notes.QT3: Complete coverage. Uniform color and sheen. No holidays, runs, or sags.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete coverage. Uniform film. Consistent sheen. No brush marks on flat sections.

tasks.name: Finish Coat — DTM Acrylic, Spray
tasks.description: Spray-apply DTM acrylic finish coat. Per coat — 2 coats total. For production gutter runs and straight railings.

quality_notes.QT3: Complete coverage. Uniform color and sheen. No runs, sags, or orange peel.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete coverage. Uniform film. Even sheen. No overspray on adjacent.

tasks.name: Ornamental Detail Finish (EA Items)
tasks.description: Detailed brush finish on ornamental iron and misc discrete items. Per coat — 2 coats total. Artist-quality brush work on complex 3D profiles.

quality_notes.QT3: Complete coverage. No holidays. Uniform appearance.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete coverage. Uniform film on all profiles. No runs or sags.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Finish coat 1 -> Recoat interval (2-4 hr) -> Finish coat 2. Brush or spray per application_method.

sop_modules.name: Intercoat Inspection
sop_modules.description: Inspection between finish coats. QT4 adds intercoat sand. All tiers get visual inspection and defect marking.

tasks.name: Intercoat Visual Inspection
tasks.description: Inspect first finish coat for holidays, runs, sags, and missed areas. Mark defects for correction before second coat.

quality_notes.QT3: Walk-around inspection. All visible defects marked.
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic close-range inspection. All defects marked.

tasks.name: Intercoat Scuff Sand (QT4)
tasks.description: Light scuff sand between finish coats for mechanical adhesion profile. 220-grit. QT4 only.

quality_notes.QT4: Light uniform scuff. No cut-through to primer.

tasks.name: Intercoat Defect Repair
tasks.description: Correct marked defects — sand runs/sags, touch up holidays and missed areas.

quality_notes.all: All marked defects corrected. Repaired areas ready for second coat.

tasks.name: Intercoat Dust Removal
tasks.description: Tack cloth wipe to remove sanding dust before second finish coat.

quality_notes.all: Surface tack-cloth clean. No dust particles.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect -> Sand (QT4) -> Repair defects -> Dust removal -> Second finish coat.

sop_modules.name: Final Inspection & Touch-Up
sop_modules.description: Final inspection of all coated metal surfaces after second finish coat. Holiday detection, touch-up, quality verification.

tasks.name: Final Inspection
tasks.description: Visual inspection of all coated metal surfaces for holidays, runs, sags, missed areas, color/sheen consistency. Systematic walk-around at multiple distances.

quality_notes.QT3: Walk-around inspection. All visible defects marked.
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic inspection at close range. All defects marked. Film build spot-checked.

tasks.name: Touch-Up Defects
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of marked defects — holidays, light spots, runs (sand and recoat), missed areas.

quality_notes.QT3: All marked defects corrected. Uniform appearance.
quality_notes.QT4: All defects corrected. Touch-up blends with surrounding finish.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect all surfaces -> Mark defects -> Touch up -> Verify.

sop_modules.name: Protection Teardown & Site Cleanup
sop_modules.description: Remove all protection materials, teardown scaffold (if used), clean equipment, dispose of hazardous waste (solvent rags, rust converter bottles).

tasks.name: Remove Protection Materials
tasks.description: Remove all tarps, plastic, tape, masking. Careful tape removal to avoid pulling fresh paint. Spot-clean any overspray on protected surfaces.

quality_notes.all: All protection removed. No tape residue. Adjacent surfaces clean.

tasks.name: Scaffold / Lift Teardown
tasks.description: Disassemble scaffolding or retrieve lift. 2-person crew.

quality_notes.all: All scaffold components removed. No building damage. Hardware collected.

tasks.name: Final Site Cleanup
tasks.description: Collect all debris (wire brush fragments, grinding dust, rust flakes, solvent rags). Clean equipment. Dispose hazardous waste per local regulations. Metal prep generates more hazardous debris than standard painting.

quality_notes.all: Work area clean. All debris collected. Hazardous waste properly disposed. Equipment cleaned.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Remove protection -> Scaffold teardown (if applicable) -> Site cleanup and hazardous waste disposal.
